title: Trump gave Xi Jinping a warm welcome. What did the talks accomplish?
content: From the National Archives to the state dinner, President Trump and Xi Jinping looked comfortable together in Washington. Two former NPR China correspondents on what the visit did and didn't deliver.

title: Trump calls Iranian plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz not 'acceptable'
content: President Trump said he was rejecting an Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian proposal is similar to a memorandum of understanding agreed upon by the U.S. and Iran back in June.

title: OpenAI says its models engaged with US government websites in misbehavior disclosure
content: The disclosure is the latest in a string of incidents in which the AI platform has been caught going rogue. OpenAI says it is reviewing the findings.

title: OPINION: Trump's U.N. speech, a stark contrast with past presidents
content: President Donald Trump mused openly before the United Nations about whether he should annihilate Iran. It's a stark contrast to how his predecessors have spoken about wielding US military power.

title: Windy weddings and rocky cruises: How East Coasters are braving the nor'easter this weekend
content: Northeast states saw rising tides and widespread power outages on Saturday as the storm ripped through the region. Forecasters expect significant winds and rain throughout the weekend.

title: Why this island paradise has the world's fastest-growing HIV epidemic
content: In mid-September, Fiji's government declared a national emergency because of a startling rise in HIV infections. The country's crystal meth epidemic is a strong contributing factor.

title: The AI safety debate is confusing. Here's our guide to the different factions
content: The battle over AI's promise and perils is not a clash between two opposing sides, but a debate among a range of competing voices and ideologies. Here is a guide to who's who in that debate.

title: Meal deliveries can save money and improve health. Will they survive Medicaid cuts?
content: Some states deliver meals to Medicaid patients that address their dietary needs. Evidence shows it aids recovery and saves healthcare costs, but federal budget cuts may lead some states to cancel it.

title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits
content: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval. Now those patients' children want recognition.

title: Pope warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity as he opens France trip
content: Pope Leo XIV has warned that a "paradise of machines" could undermine humanity. He raises concerns about artificial intelligence, nuclear arms, and human rights during his visit to France.
